xmldoc.short_description: Compress and decompress gzip data and .gz files.

param_input_item.param_description: uint8 vector, character vector or string scalar (text is compressed as UTF-8).
a uint8 vector: one or more gzip members.
compression level: 0 (no compression) to 9 (small), -1 for the zlib default (6). Default: -1.
largest accepted decompressed size in bytes (default: Inf).
a positive number: data whose decompressed size is more than maxratio times its compressed size raises an error (default: Inf, no limit).
a character vector: text encoding used to decode or encode the data (default: 'UTF-8').
strings: file names. By default compressfile adds '.gz' and decompressfile removes it.
for fopen: a .gz file name, uint8 bytes, or an http/https URL (read only).
a string: .gz file to write ('w') or to extend ('a').

param_output_item.param_description: a character vector: name of the written file.
a logical: always true, gzip is part of every build.
a string: version of the zlib library.
a file identifier for fread, fgetl, fgets, fscanf, textscan, fwrite, fprintf, feof, ftell, fseek, frewind and fclose.

description.p: nelson.io.gzip compresses and decompresses data in the gzip format (RFC 1952) with the zlib library, in memory or between files.
Decompression checks the checksum of each member and stops with an error on truncated or damaged data. Several gzip members put one after the other are read as one stream.
decompresstext decodes the decompressed bytes as text.
MaxSize protects against data that expands far beyond what is expected.

MaxCompressionRatio is checked while decompressing with decompress, decompresstext and decompressfile. decompressfile also stops when the output would be larger than the free disk space of the destination. When it fails, no destination file is left.
Files are processed in blocks, so their size is not limited by memory. The destination is written to a temporary file and replaced only when the operation succeeds.
decompressfile without destination removes the '.gz' extension; a source name without this extension raises the error Nelson:io:gzip:destinationExpected.

fopen opens gzip data as a file identifier: the usual file functions read or write it block by block. A URL is downloaded to a temporary file first. A .gz file written this way appears under its name when fclose succeeds.
Mode 'a' adds a new gzip member at the end of an existing .gz file: reading the file then returns the old data followed by the new data.
tobytes finishes a writer opened with fopen([], 'w'), closes its identifier and returns the compressed bytes.
Positioning is exact. Decoded bytes are kept in a temporary file: moving backward is slow only the first time.

xmldoc.bibliography: RFC 1952: GZIP file format specification version 4.3.
